title: How to Build a Rental and Booking Platform With AI (Airbnb-Style)
summary: Learn how to build a rental booking platform with AI in hours. Property listings, calendar, payments, reviews — database, auth, and hosting all included. No config.
body_markdown: A core rental platform — listings, calendar, booking flow, Stripe payments, and both dashboards — takes 4–6 hours using Blink. The two-sided payment flow (Stripe Connect for host payouts) is the most involved step; Blink handles the webhook logic automatically. Add a day or two for custom features like real-time messaging or dynamic pricing.
